title: How Doing the Job Nobody Notices Trains a Godly Man's Humility
caption:
A godly man does the job no one will ever see. That's where humility actually gets built.

Take the task nobody's tracking. Let someone else get the credit you earned. Ask a question that might prove you wrong.

Philippians 2: Christ emptied himself before anyone called him Lord. Kneel first. Standing up front was never the point.
